## Checklist

- [ ] My PR title follows the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) spec
- [ ] I have linked the related issue(s)
- [ ] My changes are scoped and under ~500 changed lines (split if larger)
- [ ] I have added/updated tests covering new behavior (min 80% coverage on new code)
- [ ] I have run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` locally
- [ ] I have updated documentation where relevant
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included (verified by CI secret scan)
- [ ] Schema changes include a migration file and the `module:db` label
